entities.summary: The earliest inhabitants of the Paraguayan region were hunter-gatherer peoples of the Chaco and eastern forests. The Guaraní, a Tupí-Guaraní-speaking agricultural people, expanded southward from the Amazon basin, becoming the dominant population across eastern Paraguay, southern Brazil, and northeas
